title: Kidney-AI: Multi-Modal Deep Learning and Machine Learning Framework for Chronic Kidney Disease Staging and Renal Prognosis
description: Comprehensive clinical artificial intelligence benchmark combining machine learning and deep learning for nephrology prognosis, eGFR staging, and early kidney disease detection.
